title: Right to Information Rules, 2012 — G.S.R. 603(E)
issuer: Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India
excerpt: Rule 3 sets a ten-rupee application fee and an ordinary 500-word limit without rejection solely for excess length; Rules 5 and 6 govern BPL exemption and payment modes.
notes: The official DoPT file is a larger compilation containing G.S.R. 603(E). It was downloaded as inert data, size-capped, signature checked, hashed and scanned with Microsoft Defender.

technical.notes: Rules 3 to 6 verified in the official compilation.
